definition.description: Whether the patient has experienced a recurrence of the disease.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment clinical record indicates the return of the disease after a period of remission or successful treatment.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation does not explicitly state whether the disease has recurred or if the information is ambiguous.
definition.name: disease_recurrence

definition.description: The current clinical status of the patient's disease, indicating whether the patient is in remission or has active disease.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported disease status from the patient record; identify 'NED' or 'no evidence of disease' as No Evidence of Disease, and identify mentions of active disease, disease progression, or current administration of therapy (e.g., 'third-line') as Active Disease.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: disease_status

definition.description: Presence of dizziness in the patient prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether dizziness is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dizziness is not mentioned or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: dizziness_present

definition.description: The openness or patency of the dural venous sinuses, indicating the absence of thrombosis or obstructive filling defects.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of dural sinus patency from neuroimaging reports (e.g., MRI with contrast, CT venography). Identify terms such as 'patent' or 'without filling defects' for a patent status, and 'occluded', 'thrombosed', or 'filling defect' for a non-patent status.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dural sinus patency is not mentioned or cannot be determined from the provided text.
definition.name: dural_sinus_patency

definition.description: Presence or absence of dysplasia as determined by pretreatment pathology or immunohistochemistry.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of dysplasia from pathology or ancillary immunohistochemistry (IHC) reports in the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If dysplasia is not mentioned or the status is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: dysplasia_status

definition.description: The severity of shortness of breath (dyspnea) experienced by the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the severity of dyspnea or shortness of breath. Priority should be given to PRO-CTCAE grades (0: None, 1: Mild, 2: Moderate, 3: Severe, 4: Life-threatening). Descriptive terms in clinical notes (e.g., 'mild', 'moderate', 'severe') should be mapped to the corresponding category. Reports of 'no dyspnea' or 'denies shortness of breath' should be mapped to 'None'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dyspnea is not documented or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine a severity level.
definition.name: dyspnea

definition.description: Presence of shortness of breath during physical activity.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient is reported to have dyspnea on exertion (DOE) from the pretreatment clinical records, including the History of Present Illness and Review of Systems.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dyspnea on exertion is not mentioned or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: dyspnea_on_exertion

definition.description: The severity grade of dyspnea (shortness of breath) as reported by the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical severity grade (0-4) for dyspnea or shortness of breath from patient-reported outcome instruments, specifically the PRO-CTCAE scale, where 0 = None, 1 = Mild, 2 = Moderate, 3 = Severe, and 4 = Life-threatening/Disabling.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the dyspnea severity grade is not documented or the PRO-CTCAE assessment is absent.
definition.name: dyspnea_severity

definition.description: Patient functional status measured by the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric ECOG performance status score (typically 0-5) from the pretreatment clinical record, typically found in the physical examination or assessment sections.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the ECOG status is not documented or is described ambiguously (e.g., a range like '0-1').
definition.name: ecog_performance_status

definition.description: Whether edema is present in the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether edema is explicitly documented as present or absent in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no mention of edema is found in the record.
definition.name: edema_presence

evidence_ids: at most 12 representative supplied modeling evidence IDs
themes.name: theme

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
